      Natural Language Statement

      Theorem

      The 327 shop problems of The Scheduling Zoo, each as a specification, and the 237 relations of the zoo among them that are derived here.

      A relation of the zoo states that one problem generalizes another. The 221 relations of the first list hold field by field, so that the more special problem is a special case of the more general one. The 16 relations of the second list need a threshold step, so that the decision version of the more special problem reduces to that of the more general one. Each pair lists the more general problem first.

      Theorem. Every pair of the first list is a special case, and every pair of the second list is a reduction of decision versions.
